Oct 4, 2021

Updated: Apr 16, 2023





Things you have to know about TEA


  • 2 years old

  • mixed breed

  • around 21-2 kg


  • placed in foster home where she's surrounded by dogs and puppies with whom she is brilliant

  • playful, lively and a cuddler, loves people's attention

  • very active and a bit of mischevious, skilled at jumping over the fence so we’d like for the fence to be at least 6ft otherwise she should be monitored and kept entertained

  • lives inside the house but isn't entirely toilet trained, now and then there is small toilet accident

  • not lead trained, so she'll need a bit of guidance, but as a clever girl she is, it won't be difficult at teaching her anything

  • hasn't been around kids, so we'd prefer to home her with older & dog savvy children

  • fully vaccinated, healthy and spayed




How do you adopt TEA?


Adoption requires a pre-adoption questionnaire, home check and an adoption contract. You will need to pay for TEA's 'transportation, and pay for the paperwork to get her to you. The costs are typically €550in total, depending on where you are located.


We used to be able to charge a little less but unfortunately, due to brexit, the costs of passports, documentation and travel have been increased by our suppliers.


For more information please contact our facebook page or email misisrescue@gmail.com To apply for TEA, please fill in our adoption questionnaire.
